incidents.name: Beefy Moo CAKE CTX share-price donation inflation
incidents.notes: The Moo CAKE CTX vault derives its share price from the StrategySyrup balance, which counts CAKE that anyone can donate to the underlying SmartChef, so a donation followed by depositAll()/withdrawAll() returned more CAKE than was put in.

sources.ref: onchain review: vault 0x489afbAED0Ea796712c9A6d366C16CA3876D8184 created 2020-10-27T18:44:49Z (block 1717330, tx 0x4d92d7691edbd013f3ac32cc4c300efe19fbb3f312bfc2d208351525ceb235bd) by 0xc362fa359031a081d21cb9d57c29e055fecbcb06, unrelated to attack sender 0x35700c4a7bd65048f01d6675f09d15771c0facd5; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. lossUsd uses the ~$140k reported by DeFiHackLabs; the exploit transaction moved ~53,786 CAKE out of the SmartChef and 37.5 WBNB to the attacker's addresses.
